name: docpipe
description: Small Haxe/Node.js toolkit for document pipelines: promise-based shell, WeasyPrint/poppler/pdftk PDF helpers and corner-first QR code scanning.
releasenote: Fixes: footer text escaped; Shell.execIn/execWithEnv return text; QR corner crop fits a 25 mm code; safe quoting of paths. Adds Csv reader and checks.
